nodes.rationale: Zero-variance component z-score returns NaN (not 0.0). Weight redistributed proportionally among valid components instead of masking stale data as neutral (0.0). ILI status set to DEGRADED_COMPONENT_STALE.

nodes.label: FINOS CDM Subset Projection
nodes.rationale: Use a CDM projection for instrument type standardization in API contracts and database schema. Adopt only the instrument types consumed by tickonomics (Repo, SOFR, T-Bill, equity). Avoid full model adoption — limits complexity and boilerplate.

nodes.label: IR Score Gating (ir_score < 0.90 → NEUTRAL)
nodes.rationale: No signal transitions to ACTIONABLE if ir_score < 0.90. Transparency of the Coding Rules path is the absolute requirement for institutional deployment. (Coupette & Fleckner, 2026)

nodes.label: Universe Mean MANDATE (Eq. 293)
nodes.rationale: All equity alpha strategies requiring cross-sectional de-meaning MUST use the output of the UniverseAggregator service. Independent mean calculation is strictly prohibited to ensure mathematical consistency.

nodes.label: Day-Count Conventions (ACT/365, ACT/360, ACT/ACT)
nodes.rationale: Equity Options MUST use ACT/365 day-count convention. IR Options MUST use ACT/360. US Treasury Bonds MUST use ACT/ACT. Mismatch between track conventions will result in signal drift and P&L leakage.

nodes.label: Volume-Scaled Slippage (Eq. 553, zeta=0.15)
nodes.rationale: Cost (bps) = zeta * sigma / V_ADDV * |Shares|. zeta = 0.15 (Market Impact Coefficient). Strategies that collapse under volume-scaled slippage are marked LIQUIDITY_FRAGILE.

nodes.label: Leg Symmetry Constraint (Butterfly K2 midpoint)
nodes.rationale: Butterfly requires K2 = (K1+K3)/2 within 0.01 tolerance. Three Strikes (K1 < K2 < K3). MIDPOINT CONSTRAINT: K2 = (K1 + K3) / 2 (Symmetric Wings). RATIO CONSTRAINT: +1 K1, -2 K2, +1 K3.

nodes.label: BH-FDR False-Positive Control
nodes.rationale: Benjamini-Hochberg FDR correction prevents p-hacking in strategy selection. P(i) <= (i/m) * Q where m is total tests, i is rank, Q is false discovery rate target.

nodes.label: TimescaleDB Single-Database Architecture
nodes.rationale: Single database: TimescaleDB (PostgreSQL + time-series extension). Replaces v5 dual-database architecture (QuestDB + PostgreSQL) with a single instance handling both time-series (hypertables) and relational data (regular tables). Schema migrations use Flyway only.

nodes.label: AIC Lag Selection Loop (Finding 2)
nodes.rationale: AIC lag selection pushed entirely into the Python analytics worker (Track 3). Java sends data once, receives optimal result. Arrow IPC replaces REST/JSON for high-throughput time-series transfer. Eliminates N*10 REST call explosion.

nodes.label: Tiered Storage Strategy (Hot/Cold Path)
nodes.rationale: Hot Path: QuestDB/TimeBase-CE for last 24-48h tick data. Cold Path: TimescaleDB for aggregated historical data. QuestDB excels at ingestion speed (4M rows/sec); TimescaleDB is superior for complex join-heavy analytics.

nodes.rationale: Create a CDM Adapter layer that maps ingested raw data into canonical CDM objects before reaching the ComputationEngine, ensuring standardized data model regardless of source.

nodes.label: Autoencoder-Based Data Quality Management
nodes.rationale: Train autoencoder on ILI component vectors. Flag data as SUSPECT_ANOMALY when reconstruction MSE exceeds learned threshold (3x training MSE). Two-layer framework: autoencoder for sudden anomalies + drift-diffusion for gradual parameter shift.

nodes.label: Stochastic Drift and Hitting-Time Framework
nodes.rationale: Ito diffusion model dXt = mu(t,Xt)dt + sigma(t,Xt)dWt for volatility forecasting beyond GARCH. Barrier hitting-time statistics for strategy robustness evaluation during liquidity stress events.

nodes.label: Idempotency Keys in Ingestion Layer
nodes.rationale: Every external API request carries idempotency key (UUID). TimescaleDbWriter uses INSERT ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING to prevent duplicate writes during network retries.

nodes.label: Last Known Good (LKG) Cache
nodes.rationale: In-memory LKG cache for each critical data source (FRED/NY Fed). When circuit breaker opens, serve LKG value with X-Data-Age: STALE header.

nodes.label: Bulkhead Pattern (Executor Service Isolation)
nodes.rationale: Three dedicated executor pools: Critical Ingestion (FRED/NY Fed), High-Volume Ingestion (Finnhub WS), Computation Engine (ILI/Signals). Prevents single misbehaving service from starving core KPI processing.

nodes.label: Liquidity Stress Testing Module
nodes.rationale: Simulate extreme liquidity withdrawal scenarios based on 2015 Swiss franc cap removal model. Algorithmic traders withdraw liquidity during extreme stress causing rapid market deterioration.

nodes.label: GARCH Volatility-Aware Regime Engine
nodes.rationale: GARCH(1,1) models time-varying conditional variance for volatility regime classification. Regime Classification: Low-Vol (forecast < 25th pctile), Normal (25th-75th), High-Vol (> 75th). Primary upgrade from current K-means.

nodes.label: CNN-LSTM Deep Learning Ensemble
nodes.rationale: Hybrid CNN-LSTM captures both spatial (feature relationships) and temporal dependencies. Pluggable alternative A to GARCH regime detector.

nodes.label: QED (Quantum Equilibrium-Disequilibrium) Model
nodes.rationale: Replaces GBM with metastable quartic potential. Models markets as open systems influenced by capital flows (RRP Drain Velocity, TGA Balance Change). Pluggable alternative B.

nodes.label: Event-Based Intrinsic Time
nodes.rationale: Event-based time provides parsimonious event-aware framework. Maps raw tick data into directional changes and overshoots. SurpriseIndicator uses entropy to calculate unlikeliness of price trajectories.

nodes.label: Climate-Liquidity Sensitivity Factor
nodes.rationale: As global energy mix shifts, normal RRP and TGA levels may shift requiring ILI threshold adjustments. Integrates multi-country trade model for energy shift dynamics.

nodes.label: Natural Disaster Exogenous Shock Detection
nodes.rationale: HFT algorithms react to earthquake early warning systems. Proactively flag ILI as DISLOCATED within 30 seconds of major disaster alert. New EXOGENOUS_SHOCK regime type.

nodes.label: Bayesian Optimization (Closed-Loop Controller)
nodes.rationale: Four-stage closed-loop controller: Metric Collector -> Fitness Evaluator (multi-objective) -> Bayesian Optimizer -> Policy Injector (hot-reload via PUT /api/v1/config). Three profiles: Profit Maximizer, Throughput Maximizer, Regime Adaptor.

nodes.label: Firefly Algorithm Optimizer (Alternative)
nodes.rationale: Population-based metaheuristic from SSRN-2639019. Faster convergence for high-dimensional parameter spaces. A/B testing candidate against Bayesian optimizer.

nodes.label: Ambiguity Aversion Guardrails
nodes.rationale: Compute uncertainty band instead of single ILI value. If gap between bounds exceeds threshold, mark ILI as UNCERTAIN and suppress signals. WeightOptimizer supports Worst-Case Optimization mode.

nodes.label: Multi-Dimensional Parameter Scanning
nodes.rationale: Grid searches or Sobol sequences across ILI weights, buy/sell percentiles, and cooldown period. Prevents overfitting to single narrow optimum.

nodes.label: Riemann Zeta Discrete Monitoring Correction
nodes.rationale: Continuous-to-discrete barrier adjustment using beta = -zeta(1/2)/sqrt(2*pi) ~ 0.5826. Corrects bias from sampling continuous liquidity at discrete points.

nodes.label: Return Gap Performance Diagnostic
nodes.rationale: ReturnGap = InvestorGrossReturn - HoldingsReturn. Separates interim trading skill from static holdings returns. Measures execution alpha.

nodes.label: DeRoundingFilter and TimePeriodicityFilter
nodes.rationale: DeRoundingFilter smooths volume spikes at round time marks caused by human programmer bias (SSRN-2375739). TimePeriodicityFilter adjusts 1-second algorithmic loop artifacts (SSRN-2496669).

nodes.label: Four-Layer Safety System (Defense-in-Depth)
nodes.rationale: Layer 1 PRE-TRADE: Market Stability Guardrails. Layer 2 DURING-TRADE: AUMF Scenario Engine. Layer 3 SYSTEMIC: Systemic Resilience Monitor. Layer 4 POST-TRADE: Auditability & Behavioral Safety. Optional: Gamma/GEX Market Microstructure Risk.

nodes.label: Algorithm Uncertainty Management Framework (AUMF)
nodes.rationale: Five-stage model: categorize previous cases, identify algorithm behavior, create scenarios, define best practices, design algorithm response. AumfStatus: SAFE_MODE, SUSPENDED_UNCERTAINTY, PROCEED_CAUTIOUSLY.

nodes.label: Market Gamma/GEX Monitor
nodes.rationale: Estimate net gamma exposure of market makers. Short Gamma: delta-hedging requires selling into falling market (pro-cyclical). GEX-weighted regime detection. 6th axis on Systemic Risk Heatmap.

nodes.label: Liquidity Comovement Monitor
nodes.rationale: PCA on 5-minute bucketed first-differenced standardized spreads. Rolling Comovement Factor as leading indicator for systemic stress (SSRN-2337523).

nodes.label: Phantom Liquidity Detection (PLI)
nodes.rationale: Phantom Liquidity Index compares canceled-to-executed volume. High ratio indicates unreliable funding depth. PLI used as fill probability filter in PaperTradingEngine.

nodes.label: Behavioural Risk Index (BRI)
nodes.rationale: Tracks herding, panic, overconfidence via order book microstructure and sentiment. 5th axis on Systemic Risk Heatmap. Herding Filter suppresses signals during Extreme Herding periods.

nodes.label: Intraday Liquidity Pattern (Reverse U-Shape)
nodes.rationale: TimeOfDayThresholdManager makes signal thresholds adaptive based on time-of-day. Tighten during high-asymmetry open/close; relax mid-day. Liquidity-aware execution delays signals 1-2 intervals at open/close.

nodes.label: Defining Range (DR) Session Filter
nodes.rationale: Price range between 9:30-10:30 AM EST has 85% probability of containing intraday high or low (SSRN-4492355). Signal confidence decays during +/-30 min of high-impact news.

nodes.label: Formulaic Alpha Library (101 Alphas)
nodes.rationale: 101 formulaic alphas (SSRN-2701346) for signal generation. Common interface: double[] compute(AlphaInputData). MegaAlphaEngine combines alphas via configurable weights with industry-neutralization.

nodes.label: Markov-Modulated Optimal Stops
nodes.rationale: Replace static stop-loss/take-profit with state-dependent levels from Markov-modulated diffusion (SSRN-2381830). Stop levels adjust in real-time as strategy moves through signal lifecycle.

nodes.label: Leverage Rotation Strategy (200-day MA)
nodes.rationale: Systematic rotation between leveraged equity and risk-free assets guided by S&P 500 200-day MA (SSRN-2741701). Rotates into T-bills during risk-off regimes.

nodes.label: Pairs Trading Verification (Orthogonal Signal)
nodes.rationale: Minimum-distance pairs (SSRN-141615) as orthogonal signal verification. Divergence between ILI signals and pairs signals indicates liquidity-driven market dislocation.

nodes.label: Portfolio Management Algebra
nodes.rationale: Standardized cost model: Trading costs = (t0 + t1)P + sP (SSRN-2314590). Margin call equation integrated into VirtualPortfolio rebalancing engine.

nodes.label: FinBERT Sentiment Intelligence
nodes.rationale: FinBERT (ProsusAI/finbert) replaces TextBlob for contextual financial sentiment. Identifies Hawkish/Dovish shifts in Fed sentiment days before FRED quantitative data reflects them.

nodes.label: Sentiment-Augmented Liquidity Index (SALI)
nodes.rationale: Lexicon-based lighter alternative to FinBERT. Combines ILI with sentiment using configurable weighting (70/30) or AND-gate logic. Both TA and SA branches must agree for signal confirmation.

nodes.label: FinRL Adaptive Trading Agent (PPO)
nodes.rationale: PPO agent replacing fixed percentile thresholds with continuous action space [-1, 1]. State: ILI, Z-scores, Beta, Volatility Regime, recent returns, portfolio exposure. Reward: maximize Sharpe with risk penalties.

nodes.label: TD3 Continuous Action Space Execution
nodes.rationale: Twin-Delayed DDPG with Actor-Critic architecture. Dynamic position sizing (23% instead of fixed 5%). Logarithmic return reward. Alternative B pluggable agent.

nodes.label: AgnosticAggregator (Online Learning/Regret Minimization)
nodes.rationale: Aggregates multiple weight-sets using regret-minimization algorithm (Exponential Weights). Self-optimizing weight system for non-ergodic financial data (SSRN-5242085).

nodes.label: Multi-Model Tournament Benchmarking
nodes.rationale: Benchmark ILI against XGBoost, LSTM, MLP, SVM. Voting Classifier requires ILI signal to be voted on by at least one other ML model. Regime-specific benchmarking (Uptrend/Sideways/Downtrend).

nodes.label: Statistical Integrity Dashboard (Visual Diagnostics)
nodes.rationale: QQ-Plot for Heavy Tail detection, ACF chart for volatility persistence, Convergence Plot for sample adequacy. Validates Gaussian/non-Gaussian assumptions in ILI and signal models.

nodes.label: MarketEfficiencyMonitor (Fundamental-Algorithmic Gap)
nodes.rationale: Visualizes drift between fundamental ILI value and algorithmic high-frequency volume imbalance. Flags periods where price discovery is driven by AT noise vs. fundamental macro events.

nodes.label: Monetary Policy Sensitivity Panel
nodes.rationale: Dashboard panel showing Fed balance sheet trends, key policy rates, and yield curve shape as macro regime signals. Data ingested from FRED central bank balance sheet data.

nodes.label: Spectral Bond Engine (Sturm-Liouville Decomposition)
nodes.rationale: One-factor interest rate models cast into self-adjoint Sturm-Liouville form. Bond prices as infinite sums of eigenfunctions. 10x-100x faster convergence for sensitivity calculations vs Monte Carlo (SSRN-5047749).

nodes.label: Q-World Integration (P-world/Q-world Bridge)
nodes.rationale: CIR/Heston models for fair-value yield of 3M T-Bill. Risk-Premium Residual Monitor compares P-world observed spread vs Q-world fair value. Validates DISLOCATED status from ProxyDivergenceGuard (SSRN-1717163).

nodes.label: MarketSensitivityLibrary (Standardized Greeks)
nodes.rationale: Formalize all risk sensitivities into standardized Greeks nomenclature: Repo-Delta, Rate-Delta, Rate-Gamma, Spread-Delta, Volga. Sensitivity-adjusted signal logic.

nodes.label: CVA/FVA Valuation Adjustments
nodes.rationale: Credit Valuation Adjustment, Debt Valuation Adjustment, Funding Valuation Adjustment. VirtualPortfolio reports Adjusted NAV reflecting all three adjustments (SSRN-2396545).
